init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed PyTorch training mode for single, multi-GPU, or SLURM jobs
average_metrics: average a dictionary of metrics across all distributed workers with optional weighting
all_reduce: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all distributed processes
setup_logging_for_distributed: configure logging and print to output only from the master process in distributed mode
save_on_master: save a torch tensor or model checkpoint only from the main process
